recommendations.change: Shoe homepage: add actual assembled/raw lifecycle while explicitly retaining/render-labelling existing card image. Keep product status/6 real photos/7th planning stage and no-final-finish statement.

Flow: explicit planning status in both family card and detail; replace vague photos-coming-soon with current no-product-photographs language. Do not add image URLs or imply fabricated/finished object.
Use consistent, minimal lifecycle words on all eight cards and linked pages. Tables family needs mixed status; show Geometric built and Flow planning individually.
Kids/drill: built/workshop-photo labels; replace homepage "finished" alts with as-built. Current raw wood photographs do not establish painted/finished coating.
Geometric planning board: label planning/renderings/drawings; do not call entire planning board a product photograph. Documentary stage photos may retain photo labels.

Workbench/crib/etrog/scroll pages already explicit planning/render status: preserve existing notes, diagram labels and crib safety warning; only standardize concise visible card provenance if required.

uncertainties: The audit distinguishes workshop photographs visually and by repository provenance. No external EXIF/photographer chain-of-custody verification was performed.
Kids/drill as-built images do not establish surface finishing or paint. Avoid treating a carousel stage named Finishing as proof of a painted finish.
Geometric planning-clean.webp is a mixed illustration board including authentic thumbnails; a broad label should say planning/renderings, not pure CAD drawing or authentic product photo.
Flow lacks product photographs; this does not independently prove whether any physical prototype exists. The supported public description is planning/design files and no available photographs.
